# SB-1025 Safety bulletin: quench oil fire risk

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P1, line P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-RR01

Hazard description
- During ring rolling operations, accumulation of quench oil on hot surfaces and within guarding areas has been identified as a potential fire initiation source. Oil mist and pooled oil can ignite when exposed to radiant heat from the roll pack and hot workpieces. Poor housekeeping, degraded seals, and inadequate containment increase the likelihood of an uncontrolled quench oil fire that could spread to adjacent machinery and electrical systems.

Affected equipment
- Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) located on P1-L1 is affected. Bearings, seals, drip trays, and splash shields on EQ-P1-L1-RR01 are primary concern areas. Refer to maintenance history in MM-P1-L1-RR01 for recent quench oil-related entries and to SOP-P1-L1-04 and SOP-P1-L1-05 for current operational and shutdown procedures.

Required controls
- Immediately increase visual inspections for oil accumulation on and around EQ-P1-L1-RR01 during every shift. Remove pooled oil and clean contaminated surfaces using approved absorbents; place used absorbents in metal containers with lids and store in designated fireproof waste areas.
- Verify containment: ensure drip trays and splash shields are correctly installed, free of debris, and routed to containment sumps. Replace or repair degraded seals on EQ-P1-L1-RR01 per MM-P1-L1-RR01.
- Lubrication schedule note: The main roll bearing lubrication interval for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) is 120 hours. Verify lubrication events are recorded and that lubrication points are wiped clean before service to prevent oil spray on hot surfaces.
- Update SOP adherence: Ensure operators follow SOP-P1-L1-04 for start-up and steady-state operations and SOP-P1-L1-05 for shutdown and maintenance isolation. Include an explicit oil-control checklist in pre-shift inspections.
- Fire protection: Confirm local portable extinguishers and fixed suppression interfaces near EQ-P1-L1-RR01 are serviceable and unobstructed; report deficiencies immediately to maintenance per MM-P1-L1-RR01.

Effective date
- Effective date: Upon issue. Implement controls immediately and report compliance to line supervision.
